dom.style: display: flex; flex-direction: row; width: 100%; height: 100%

elements.explorer-col: .explorer-col — left column containing FileExplorerPlugin (flex-shrink:0, width: 260px default)
elements.resize-handle: .resize-handle — draggable splitter between columns (width: 2px, cursor: col-resize)

interactions.name: resize_column
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document → mouseup on document

interactions.name: open_file_from_explorer
interactions.trigger: file click in FileExplorerPlugin onFileOpen callback
interactions.action: editor.openFile(filePath) → revealFile in file tree to highlight selected file.

interactions.name: open_file_search
interactions.trigger: Ctrl+P keyboard shortcut intercepted by App
interactions.action: Create or reveal CommandPalette overlay → user selects file via fuzzy search → editor.openFile(filePath).

interactions.name: close_tab
interactions.trigger: Ctrl+W shortcut or X button on editor tab
interactions.action: editor.closeActiveTab() → if no tabs remaining, hide editor column (display: none).

interactions.name: theme_update
interactions.trigger: theme change event from TopBar or App
interactions.action: editor.updateTheme() to sync Monaco editor theme (cockpit-dark / cockpit-light).

states.editor-empty: No tabs open in editor, .editor-col hidden (display: none). Only .explorer-col visible.
states.editor-active: One or more tabs open in editor, both .explorer-col and .editor-col visible in split layout.
states.resizing: .resize-handle highlighted with accent color, .editor-col width updating in real-time as user drags.
